title: Named strict-system specifications for the diagonal limit
statement: DiagonalStrictInputSpec and DiagonalStrictLimitSpec are explicit specializations of DiagonalStrictDataSpec, sharing the existing strict-system witnesses and hom equation. The former retains the finite heterogeneous class equations; the latter uses their homogeneous finite normalization. Neither definition chooses data.

source.place: finite equation clause of the system and limit assertions

proof.text: Specialize DiagonalStrictDataSpec with the named finite input predicate or the named finite Cartier normalization. The endpoints, counit and boundary are the existing integral diagonal data.

proof_origin.place: finite equation clause of the system and limit assertions

def DiagonalStrictInputSpec (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (hY : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalMod ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (DiagonalMod ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ (diagonalSurface Y))]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ (diagonalSurface Y)))
 : Prop
